labels.name: agent-ready
labels.description: Self-contained spec; an agent can take it solo

labels.name: spike
labels.description: Research/experiment; outcome is a writeup, not a feature

labels.name: good-first-issue
labels.description: Good entry point for new contributors

issues.title: Scaffold Next.js app (App Router, TS, Tailwind, ESLint/Prettier, vitest)
issues.body:
Goal: `pnpm dev` runs a styled placeholder page; `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` all pass.

Out of scope: any feature UI.
Acceptance: fresh clone → README quickstart works.

issues.title: Supabase project setup + local dev stack (`supabase start`)
issues.body:
Goal: supabase/ dir with config; local stack boots; .env.example documents all vars; client helper in src/lib/supabase.

Acceptance: `supabase start` + `pnpm dev` → app connects locally.

issues.title: Schema v1 migration + RLS policies
issues.body:
Implement PRD §8 data model as SQL migrations: profiles, scans, climbs, holds, paths, grade_votes, reviews, area_cache. RLS: contributors edit own pending items; published immutable except via review; one grade vote per user per climb.

Contract-first: this lands before any feature PR that touches data.
Acceptance: migrations apply cleanly; RLS tested with pgTAP or scripted queries.

issues.title: CI workflow: lint + typecheck + test + build on every PR
issues.body:
GitHub Actions: pnpm cache, run lint/typecheck/vitest/build. Required check for merging to main.
Acceptance: red on intentional type error, green on main.

issues.title: Deploy skeleton to Vercel + Supabase cloud
issues.body:
Production URL live, env vars set, preview deploys on PRs.
Acceptance: public URL renders; PR preview comment appears.

issues.title: Branch protection + repo settings
issues.body:
main: PRs only, CI required, squash-merge only, delete-branch-on-merge. Issue/PR templates verified.
Acceptance: direct push to main rejected.

issues.title: Install claude-code-action: @claude on issues + reviewer agent on PRs
issues.body:
Two workflows: (1) @claude issue/PR comments spawn an agent that implements and opens a PR; (2) every PR gets a structured review comment from the reviewer agent using .claude/agents/reviewer.md guidance.
Acceptance: test issue produces a PR; test PR gets a review comment.

issues.title: Add demo scan fixture (CC-licensed or self-captured GLB) + seed script
issues.body:
A small (<10MB) boulder GLB in supabase storage via seed script, plus fixture holds JSON for viewer dev.
Acceptance: `pnpm seed` populates local stack.

issues.title: 3D viewer: GLB loading + orbit/pan/zoom (r3f + drei)
issues.body:
Load compressed GLB (Draco/meshopt) from Supabase storage URL; OrbitControls tuned for boulders (ground plane, sane limits); loading/error states; 60fps on mid phone for 500k tris.
Acceptance: demo scan orbits smoothly on desktop + mobile Safari/Chrome.

issues.title: Viewer: hold markers + climb selection UI
issues.body:
Render holds (from fixture JSON) as oriented markers on the mesh surface, colored by type (start/hand/foot/finish); climb list panel; selecting a climb highlights its holds + draws its line; info panel (name, grade, description).
Contract: Hold/Climb types from src/lib/types.ts.
Acceptance: two fixture climbs selectable, visually distinct.

issues.title: Viewer: start/topout/downclimb affordances
issues.body:
Start holds get a distinct marker; topout path and downclimb path render as dashed lines with labels; legend component.
Acceptance: fixture data renders all three.

issues.title: Boulder page shell: viewer + climb list + metadata layout
issues.body:
Route /boulder/[id]: responsive layout (viewer dominant, panel collapses on mobile), SEO/meta/OG tags, share link.
Acceptance: lighthouse mobile ≥ 85.

issues.title: Viewer performance pass: LOD/progressive loading decision
issues.body:
Spike: test 1M+ tri scans on low-end devices; evaluate meshopt LODs vs KTX2 texture compression vs progressive loading. Writeup with recommendation + budget numbers in docs/decisions/.
Acceptance: documented decision; follow-up issues filed.

issues.title: Auth: GitHub/Google OAuth + profile creation
issues.body:
Supabase auth; profiles row on first login (handle from provider, editable); auth-gated routes/middleware; sign-in UI.
Acceptance: fresh user can sign in and set handle.

issues.title: Upload flow: client → Storage (resumable) → scans row
issues.body:
Upload page: file picker + drag-drop, accept .glb/.gltf/.obj(.zip)/.ply, 200MB cap, progress bar (tus/resumable), creates scans row status=uploaded, triggers pipeline.
Acceptance: 150MB PLY uploads reliably on flaky wifi.

issues.title: QC pipeline: validate → convert → compress → thumbnail (spike then implement)
issues.body:
Edge Function (or worker if limits require — spike first, 1 day max): magic-byte check, parse mesh, PRD §9 geometry checks, convert to GLB (obj2gltf/assimp), Draco or meshopt compress via gltf-transform, headless thumbnail render, write qc_report jsonb, set status failed_qc|pending_review with actionable reasons.
Acceptance: golden test set — 5 good scans pass, 6 crafted bad files fail with correct reasons.

issues.title: QC report UI + rejection feedback to contributor
issues.body:
Contributor sees per-scan status timeline and failed checks in plain English ('texture resolution too low: 512px, need 1024px+'). Retry = new upload linked to same draft.
Acceptance: rejected scan shows all failure reasons.

issues.title: Storage strategy: Supabase vs Cloudflare R2 for meshes
issues.body:
Free tier math (1GB Supabase vs 10GB R2), egress costs at 1k views/boulder, signed URL strategy, raw-file retention policy. Writeup + decision in docs/decisions/.
Acceptance: documented; migration issue filed if needed.

issues.title: Review queue: pending scans list + approve/request-changes/reject
issues.body:
Route /review (maintainer-gated via trust_level): embedded viewer, QC report, reviewer checklist from PRD §9, verdict + reason writes reviews row and flips scan status; contributor notified (in-app, email v2).
Acceptance: full cycle approve + reject works; non-maintainers get 403.

issues.title: Publish flow + scan lifecycle state machine
issues.body:
Enforce PRD §8 status transitions in one module (uploaded→processing→failed_qc|pending_review→published|rejected) with unit tests; no ad-hoc status writes anywhere else.
Acceptance: invalid transitions throw; tests cover the matrix.

issues.title: Annotation: raycast hold placement/edit on mesh
issues.body:
Click/tap mesh → hold at intersection (position, normal, face index), type picker, drag to adjust, delete, undo/redo stack. Desktop-first; read-only on small screens is acceptable for v1.
Acceptance: place 10 holds on demo scan in <2 min without rage.

issues.title: Annotation: climb builder (sequence, line, topout, downclimb)
issues.body:
Order holds into a sequence (auto-order by click order, drag to reorder); draw topout + downclimb paths as surface polylines; name/description/proposed grade form; save as climb status=pending_review.
Acceptance: full climb authored on demo scan end-to-end.

issues.title: Annotation validity checks (server-side)
issues.body:
On climb submit: 1–2(+) start holds required, ≥3 holds total, sequence references valid holds, holds lie on mesh surface (distance tolerance vs content_hash mesh), no duplicate climb names per scan.
Acceptance: unit tests for each rule; bad payloads rejected with clear errors.

issues.title: Grade votes: vote UI + distribution display
issues.body:
V-scale picker (one vote per user per climb, changeable), histogram + consensus grade, 'sandbagged by N grades' badge when consensus > proposed/guidebook grade.
Acceptance: votes persist; distribution renders; badge logic tested.

issues.title: Climb review queue (reuse scan review infra)
issues.body:
Extend /review with pending climbs: viewer shows proposed holds/line, approve/reject.
Acceptance: climb publish cycle works.

issues.title: Annotation versioning vs scan content-hash
issues.body:
Holds store scan_content_hash; replacing a scan's mesh invalidates (flags) annotations for re-check rather than silently breaking positions.
Acceptance: mesh replacement flags dependent climbs.

issues.title: OpenBeta client: GraphQL queries + Postgres cache (spike ToS/rate limits first)
issues.body:
Day 1: confirm API ToS, rate limits, and the right queries (areas, climbs, access warnings) — post in OpenBeta Discord, introduce the project. Then: typed client, area_cache table with TTL refresh, graceful degradation when API down.
Acceptance: writeup + working cached queries for 2 test areas (e.g. Pawtuckaway, Hammond Pond).

issues.title: Attach flow: search OpenBeta area/boulder during upload
issues.body:
Typeahead search against cached/live OpenBeta data; attach scan to area + optional climb; 'can't find it' path stores freetext + link to contribute to OpenBeta itself.
Acceptance: demo scan attached to real Pawtuckaway boulder.

issues.title: Location privacy enforcement
issues.body:
location_privacy enum (exact/fuzzed_1km/hidden) on area_cache, sourced from OpenBeta access flags + manual maintainer overrides; all coordinate output passes through one formatter that enforces it; contributor can flag an area as sensitive at upload.
Values-critical (PRD §2.2). Acceptance: hidden area never leaks coords in any API response (tested).

issues.title: Browse: area index + boulder list pages
issues.body:
Routes /areas, /area/[id]: tree/list of areas with scan counts, boulder cards (thumbnail, climb count, grades), only published scans visible.
Acceptance: navigable from landing to boulder page.

issues.title: Search: boulders/climbs by name + grade filter
issues.body:
Simple Postgres FTS over published scans/climbs + grade range filter.
Acceptance: 'Lieback' finds the climb.

issues.title: Per-boulder open-data export (GLB + annotations JSON)
issues.body:
Download button: zip of canonical GLB + climbs/holds/paths/grades JSON with schema version + CC BY-SA license file + attribution list.
Acceptance: exported zip re-imports into a fresh self-hosted instance (round-trip test).

issues.title: Dataset export v0 (all published data, for ML)
issues.body:
Scripted export of the full corpus: manifest JSON + per-scan GLB + hold labels, documented in docs/dataset.md with the v2 ML plan.
Acceptance: documented format; export runs in CI weekly (artifact).

issues.title: Capture guide: how to scan a boulder well (per-app tips)
issues.body:
docs/capture-guide.md: lighting, coverage pattern, Polycam/Scaniverse/RealityScan/Luma export settings, common QC failures and fixes. Link from upload page.
Acceptance: a first-time scanner produced a passing scan using only the guide.

issues.title: Seed Pawtuckaway (or local NJ/NY area): 10 scans, 20 climbs
issues.body:
Collin field work + uploads through the real flow (dogfooding); file bugs for every papercut.
Acceptance: PRD §11 seed metrics met.

issues.title: Landing page: pitch, featured boulders, contribute CTA
issues.body:
Hero with embedded live viewer, 'how it works' (scan→upload→annotate→share), values blurb, OpenBeta credit.
Acceptance: deployed; OG preview looks good in Discord.

issues.title: Self-host verification + README polish
issues.body:
Fresh-clone test of the quickstart on a clean machine/container; fix every gap; add architecture diagram.
Acceptance: clone→running locally in <10 min, timed.

issues.title: Spike (v2): browser-guided capture + photogrammetry pipeline options
issues.body:
Research: WebXR/camera-guided capture UX, COLMAP/Meshroom server pipeline vs Apple Object Capture, cost per scan. Writeup → v2 PRD section.
Acceptance: docs/decisions/capture-v2.md with recommendation.

issues.title: Launch posts: OpenBeta community, r/bouldering, climbing Discords, Stevens
issues.body:
Coordinated posts with demo links + contribute CTA; monitor feedback; triage into issues.
Acceptance: posted; first-week feedback triaged.
